meta.promptText: Which vitamin C serum should I buy for dark spots and dull skin in India?

response.text:
For **dark spots and dull skin in India**, the safest “best buy” is usually a **stable 10–15% vitamin C serum** used every morning with sunscreen; among the options in your results, **Pilgrim 10% Vitamin C** is the best beginner-friendly pick, while **Pilgrim 15% Vitamin C** is better if your dark spots are more stubborn.[2][10][17]

- **Best for most people:** **Pilgrim 10% Vitamin C Face Serum** — a gentler daily option with **ethyl ascorbic acid** plus **niacinamide**, which is useful if you want brightness with lower irritation risk.[2]
- **Best for stubborn dark spots:** **Pilgrim 15% Vitamin C Face Serum** — a stronger option with **ferulic acid** and **vitamin E**, which are commonly paired with vitamin C for better antioxidant support.[2][17]
- **Best budget high-strength option:** **The Ordinary Vitamin C 23%** — listed as a low-price, high-potency choice for pigmentation, though higher strengths can irritate sensitive skin more easily.[1]
- **Best overall premium option:** **La Roche-Posay Pure 12% Vitamin C** — described as combining **L-ascorbic acid**, **hyaluronic acid**, and **salicylic acid** for brightening and spot-fading support.[1]

If you want the simplest answer: **buy a 10% vitamin C serum if you’re new or have sensitive skin, and 15% if you already tolerate actives and want faster dark-spot fading**.[2][10][17]

A few practical points matter more than the brand name:
- **Use it in the morning** and always pair it with **sunscreen**, because vitamin C works best when UV damage is controlled.[2][9]
- Look for **stable forms** like **ethyl ascorbic acid** or well-formulated **L-ascorbic acid**; Indian climate can make unstable formulas spoil faster.[3][17]
- If your main concern is **dullness**, a 10% serum is often enough; if it’s **post-acne marks or sun spots**, 10–15% is the more relevant range.[2][10][17]

If you want, I can narrow this down further into **best budget**, **best for oily skin**, **best for sensitive skin**, or **best under ₹500/₹1000 in India**.
